paragraphs: Deloitte delivered a full-stack, cloud-native AI application for the client to modernise and automate maintenance strategy processes across Heavy Mobile Equipment (HME) and Fixed Plant (FXP) assets. The platform replaces fragmented, manual engineering workflows with AI-augmented data review, statistical reliability modelling, and data-driven maintenance optimisation, enabling engineers to shift from reactive to proactive asset management. The solution integrates with Databricks and SAP work order systems to provide end-to-end traceability from raw operational data through to validated maintenance recommendations, delivering projected annual savings of $35 million through reduced unplanned downtime and optimised component replacement cycles.
bullets: Reliability engineering - Weibull analysis, MTBF/MTTF calculation, Asset Health Index scoring, component age analysis and replacement projection modelling.
AI-augmented engineering workflows - human-in-the-loop review for AI-generated material classifications, FLOC BOM validation and work order classification.
Full-stack web development - React/TypeScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) following a vertical-slice architecture.
Data engineering - Databricks Gold-layer enterprise data products and SAP work order data into a dual-schema PostgreSQL application database.
Azure cloud platform - Azure Container Apps with Entra ID authentication and Application Insights telemetry.
Data visualisation - interactive reliability charts including Weibull curves, age analysis timelines and health index dashboards using Plotly.js.

experience.role: Client Asset Management Framework (Phase 1 and 2) · Consultant Engineer
paragraphs: Rolled out the Client Asset Management Framework and System Definition. Defined Key Practice Areas, system requirements and documentation layout for the client. Worked with the client's central team across Australia, Chile, South Africa, Ghana and Canada to identify and align global frameworks.
bullets: Asset Management Framework definition and Key Practice Areas rollout.
Asset Management System documentation and global standardisation.
International workshopping facilitated across 5 countries using Mentimeter.

experience.role: Asset Health Index - Pilbara Sites · Consultant Engineer
paragraphs: 4/3 roster fly-in fly-out rollout and build of the Asset Health Index for the client. This involved the wet plant assets at one Pilbara site and the low-grade fixed plant at a second Pilbara site.
bullets: Power BI dashboard development to track and communicate asset health scores across sites.
Engagement with Reliability Engineers and site stakeholders to validate AHI scoring methodologies.
People engagement and RE collaboration to align the Asset Health Index with site maintenance strategies.

experience.role: Labour Benchmarking Review · Data & Reporting Analyst
bullets: Worked with national resources to collect a database of information in order to draw conclusions and summaries on industry standard for labour quantities.
Direct back-and-forth with client to ensure scope aligned with the desired outcomes and the correct conclusions were made.

Breaking down each site into major assets using exports from various sources, allowing for accurate comparisons between equivalent datasets (ensuring bias due to resource type/org structure would not affect the end result).
Report Building and collation of large data, utilising appendices and other tools to improve reading ease.
Substation site validation - Checking the correct regulatory precautions are taking in Low Voltage Substations at the site.
Recommendations are made based on historical costing and Changeout breakdown of assets - ensuring that the best measures are taken to break down each substation in scope.

experience.role: Asset Management Uplift Programme · Graduate Team Member
bullets: Bad Actor Review involving calculating the worst performing site assets on the basis of downtime and their associated criticality.

Changeout Analysis of SAP exports involving review of PM01, PM02 and PM03 changeout notifications for incomplete changeouts to find causes of unnecessary downtime on assets. This also included looking at timing issues of PM01 and PM02 notifications.
Documentation/PRT review to find gaps in task descriptions, or missing information which would make it challenging for an inspector to evaluate an assets condition.

experience.role: Closed Work Order and Parts Reallocation · Storefront
experience.dates: November 2022 - March 2024 · part time / ad hoc
paragraphs: Using SAP (S4Hana) to re-issue stock items back into the storefront that weren't fitted from maintenance orders. Also preparing work orders for fitters and maintenance crew to perform routine fixes.
bullets: Associating parts with SAP ID so that they can be re-issued into stock.
Collecting work orders and ordering parts to make service kits for the team.
Operating a stock take which involved reviewing item quantities and adjusting SAP as such.
Redistribution of hose stockpiles back into stock bins and disposing of out of date hoses to clear backlog.

project.title: Chatbot UWA Web Design · Group Member
bullets: Created a UWA questionnaire-inspired chatbot that uses the ChatGPT algorithm to answer students questions from a webpage.
HTML and CSS design by first building a framework with HTML and then adding colour and design with CSS.
JavaScript actioning which involved strategically adding buttons and capability to the page such as saving user details, passwords and navigation.

Python AI training was used to create a link between the AI from Amazon cloud servers and the various documents stored in the UWA questionnaire database. A trial and error system was used to bring the AI to ~95% accuracy.
Final Presentation was made and the product was presented to the UWA Software Engineering board which resulted in an overall positive reaction, and 90% overall project mark.

why.heading: Why ASC
why.lead: ASC's work has a purpose I find genuinely compelling. I have always enjoyed the practical side of engineering - understanding how complex equipment is maintained, making the information useful for the people doing the work, and seeing a better decision turn into a real improvement. The chance to bring that mindset to sustaining the Collins Class fleet, and to the submarine build and sustainment program ahead, is one I would be proud to take on.
why.body: At Deloitte I work with maintenance data, reliability analysis and engineering applications for resources sector clients: a full-stack maintenance strategy platform for heavy mobile equipment and fixed plant, an Asset Health Index built and rolled out across two Pilbara sites, a maintenance tactics review, and an asset management framework built with international stakeholders. The assets are different, but the job of turning maintenance data into a clear, defensible decision is the same one I already do. I am realistic that I am coming from mining rather than maritime defence, and I see this role as a genuine step toward the kind of purposeful engineering work I want to build a career in.
